# Name: # A/B OTA layout for the 16 MB ESP32-S3-N16R8. Two app slots so an update writes the INACTIVE slot and
# the bootloader can roll back to the last-good one. Slots are generous because the flash is 16 MB —
# there is no reason to squeeze them the way the 4 MB C6 build has to.
# 0x810000..0x1000000 (~7.9 MB) unallocated — room for a storage/coredump partition later.
